purpose: Centralize current-target collision boundaries between current-22 routes and researched LiuYao expansion themes/duties before any expansion training.
decisionPrinciples: Current target outranks background method, setting, destination, document mention, or domain keyword.
A route/theme keyword never wins by priority alone.
Downstream consequence is decisive when an exam, travel, dispute, or document is only an intermediate process.
Object lifecycle state separates issuance/existence, delivery, loss/recovery, purchase, and informational questions.
Actor-action questions are distinct from artifact-arrival questions even when both mention messages, documents, offers, notices, or calls.
If the deciding semantic field is unresolved, abstain or keep a partial design rather than force a neighboring route.

collisionCases.exampleA: 今年能不能升职？
collisionCases.exampleB: 今年工资能不能涨？
collisionCases.rule: position/status outcome -> career_position; salary/pay amount or increase -> income_salary

collisionCases.exampleA: 这次晋升能不能成功？
collisionCases.exampleB: 这次绩效奖金会不会发？
collisionCases.rule: career event context does not absorb payout targets

collisionCases.exampleA: 公务员笔试这一轮能不能通过？
collisionCases.exampleB: 公务员考试最终能不能拿到岗位？
collisionCases.rule: exam-stage result -> study_exam; final employment acquisition -> career_position

collisionCases.exampleA: 劳动仲裁以后我的职位能不能保住？
collisionCases.exampleB: 这次劳动仲裁裁决会不会支持我？
collisionCases.rule: employment status outranks dispute method; adjudicative outcome remains litigation

collisionCases.exampleA: A公司最后会不会录用我？
collisionCases.exampleB: HR今天会不会回复我的消息？
collisionCases.rule: employment acquisition -> career; specific person's communication action -> person_contact

collisionCases.exampleA: 奖学金评选这一轮能不能入选？
collisionCases.exampleB: 这笔奖学金的钱什么时候到账？
collisionCases.rule: selection qualification and money receipt are separate targets; finance wins when money itself is target
collisionCases.note: Exact future financial route must be resolved from the current finance inventory; do not invent a new current route in this matrix.

collisionCases.exampleA: 学校会不会正式签发我的毕业证？
collisionCases.exampleB: 毕业证什么时候寄到我手里？
collisionCases.rule: issuance/existence -> academic certificate duty; physical delivery -> receive_item

collisionCases.exampleA: 学位证能不能正常办下来？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我的学位证丢了还能找回来吗？
collisionCases.rule: document creation/issuance and lost-object recovery are separate lifecycle targets

collisionCases.exampleA: 这个项目最后会不会录取我？
collisionCases.exampleB: 导师今天会不会回复我的邮件？
collisionCases.rule: admission decision -> study; specific person's reply action -> contact

collisionCases.exampleA: 论文这周能不能定稿？
collisionCases.exampleB: 导师会不会批准我这版论文？
collisionCases.rule: artifact completion and reviewer approval are distinct duties even when both may involve 父母 traditionally

collisionCases.exampleA: 论文能不能写完？
collisionCases.exampleB: 答辩这一轮能不能通过？
collisionCases.rule: paper artifact, formal defense, and composite graduation qualification must remain separate

collisionCases.exampleA: 台风会不会导致我的航班取消？
collisionCases.exampleB: 旅游目的地明天天气怎么样？
collisionCases.rule: weather may be causal context for travel disruption but weather itself is not travel

collisionCases.exampleA: 我这趟航班能不能按时到？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我的包裹明天能不能送到？
collisionCases.rule: person/journey transport and item delivery are distinct targets

collisionCases.exampleA: 这趟旅行能不能顺利成行？
collisionCases.exampleB: 这张机票值不值得买？
collisionCases.rule: trip execution and purchase suitability are separate targets

collisionCases.exampleA: 去外地面试这趟路顺不顺？
collisionCases.exampleB: 去外地面试最后能不能录用？
collisionCases.rule: trip purpose is background unless journey itself is current target

collisionCases.exampleA: 去外地考试这趟能不能按时到？
collisionCases.exampleB: 去外地参加的考试能不能通过？
collisionCases.rule: journey execution and exam outcome remain separate

collisionCases.exampleA: 这趟出差路上顺不顺？
collisionCases.exampleB: 这次去客户那里合同能不能谈成？
collisionCases.rule: travel is context when the commercial result is the actual target

collisionCases.exampleA: 我爸这趟旅行安全吗？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我爸什么时候回来？
collisionCases.rule: represented travel safety and absent-person return/timing are separate events

collisionCases.exampleA: 这个债务官司判决会不会支持我？
collisionCases.exampleB: 起诉以后这笔欠款最终能不能收回来？
collisionCases.rule: adjudication result -> litigation; debt recovery -> debt_collection even when litigation is the method

collisionCases.exampleA: 这个合同纠纷官司我能不能赢？
collisionCases.exampleB: 对方最后会不会按合同交货？
collisionCases.rule: formal dispute outcome and contract performance are distinct targets

collisionCases.exampleA: 离婚诉讼判决会不会支持我的请求？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我们最后会不会离婚？
collisionCases.rule: judicial result and relationship/marital status are separate targets

collisionCases.exampleA: 对方会不会主动提出和解？
collisionCases.exampleB: 对方今天会不会回复我的消息？
collisionCases.rule: dispute-specific legal/settlement action remains litigation; generic communication response is person_contact

collisionCases.exampleA: 快递明确丢件了还能找回来吗？
collisionCases.exampleB: 快递怎么还没到，明天能收到吗？
collisionCases.rule: confirmed loss/recovery -> lost_property; delayed delivery without confirmed loss -> receive_item

collisionCases.exampleA: 刚买的手机丢了还能找到吗？
collisionCases.exampleB: 这台手机值不值得买？
collisionCases.rule: object identity never determines route without lifecycle/current-target context

collisionCases.exampleA: 我的钱包丢了能找回来吗？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我爸出差什么时候回来？
collisionCases.exampleC: 家人失踪了现在在哪里？
collisionCases.rule: lost_property only covers confirmed lost inanimate property; ordinary known-away return is person_return; missing-person cases are outside this theme set

collisionCases.exampleA: 他什么时候回来？
collisionCases.exampleB: 什么时候能收到他的消息？
collisionCases.rule: physical return and communication arrival are separate events

collisionCases.exampleA: 这两天能不能收到他的消息？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我发了消息，他会不会回复？
collisionCases.rule: message/news arrival artifact and person's reply action are separate current targets

collisionCases.exampleA: A公司的工作我能不能拿到？
collisionCases.exampleB: 留现在公司还是去A公司更适合？
collisionCases.rule: single outcome prediction and alternative comparison/suitability are different contracts

collisionCases.exampleA: A大学能不能录取我？
collisionCases.exampleB: A大学和B大学哪个更适合我？
collisionCases.rule: bounded admission outcome and multi-alternative suitability are separate contracts

collisionCases.exampleA: 双方最后能不能和解？
collisionCases.exampleB: 我该不该接受这份和解？
collisionCases.rule: settlement feasibility and settlement suitability/strategy are not Boolean inversions

abstentionCases.pattern: generic career/study/travel/dispute state without bounded target
legal procedural/informational question such as how to file, jurisdiction, fees, rules
missing person, disease, life/death, emergency safety outside ordinary represented travel

futureRequirements: Every new-theme training family must include reciprocal near-domain negatives from collision cases.
Do not generate keyword-only label pairs; vary shared vocabulary while holding current target different.
Preserve frozen current-22 regression examples when expansion training eventually opens.
Collision decisions must be versioned and frozen before corpus generation.

integrationNotes: This matrix is a semantic governance artifact, not a Router implementation.
Some winner labels are design duties rather than current route IDs because expansion is still design-only.
Where the current finance/commercial inventory lacks an exact future route label, the matrix states the target family rather than inventing a current route.
The matrix must be reviewed alongside future formal Event/Intent schemas before training corpus construction.
